question: Why does wine bathing liberate the seeker?
premises: In wine bathing the best practitioner seeking liberation becomes kevalī.
Wine is of the nature of Śiva.
inference: Because wine and mantras share Śiva-nature, wine bathing can bring the qualified seeker to liberation.
uncertainties: kevalībhavet may indicate isolated liberation or a specific ritual state.
plain_english: In the wine bath, the foremost practitioner who seeks liberation may become liberated, because wine is of the nature of Śiva and all mantras arise from Śiva.
